parties.respondent: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd. And Another

summary: Contractual disputes in sewage plant construction; delay attribution to HPCL for obstruction; arbitration award allowed BEEL's claims for overhead, profit, machinery idling, extra work; High Court quashed award under s.37 Arbitration Act; SC found award lacking reasoned analysis on delay causation; computational error in 10% profit/overhead awards; failure to examine contractual clauses; award set aside for non-compliance with s.31(3) Arbitration Act; remanded to decide on fresh evidentiary basis.
final_judgment: Arbitral award set aside; matter remanded to High Court for fresh consideration with proper reasoning on delay causation and contract terms.
